text: The warm sun fell on their backs. <break time="0.8s" /> And they heard nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And thought of nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> For they had forgotten. <break time="0.8s" /> The rest of the world. <break time="0.8s" /> Suddenly the ground shook. <break time="0.8s" /> With a deep roar. <break time="0.8s" /> That seemed to come from under the earth. <break time="0.8s" /> And the cannon began to thunder again. <break time="0.8s" /> Far to the left rose. <break time="0.8s" /> The dark shape of Mont Valérien. <break time="0.8s" /> From whose top. <break time="0.8s" /> White puffs of smoke burst out. <break time="0.8s" /> One after another. <break time="0.8s" /> There they go again. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Sauvage with a shrug. <break time="0.8s" /> While Morissot. <break time="0.8s" /> Who was watching his float. <break time="0.8s" /> Felt the anger of a peaceful man. <break time="0.8s" /> Against these madmen. <break time="0.8s" /> They must be stupid. <break time="0.8s" /> To kill each other like that he grumbled. <break time="0.8s" /> And Sauvage replied. <break time="0.8s" /> They are worse than animals. <break time="0.8s" /> While the two friends agreed. <break time="0.8s" /> That people would never be free. <break time="0.8s" /> The cannon kept roaring. <break time="0.8s" /> Destroying homes. <break time="0.8s" /> And leaving wounds in mothers hearts. <break time="0.8s" /> That would never heal. <break time="0.8s" /> Such is life. <break time="0.8s" /> Said Sauvage. <break time="0.8s" /> And Morissot answered with a little laugh. <break time="0.8s" /> Say rather, such is death. <break time="0.8s" /> At that moment. <break time="0.8s" /> They felt someone behind them. <break time="0.8s" /> And turning around. <break time="0.8s" /> They saw four tall, bearded soldiers. <break time="0.8s" /> Pointing rifles at them. <break time="0.8s" /> Their rods dropped from their hands. <break time="0.8s" /> And floated away. <break time="0.8s" /> And within seconds. <break time="0.8s" /> The two friends were tied up. <break time="0.8s" /> Put into a boat. <break time="0.8s" /> And taken to the island.
